description: This file defines a Java class `ReadableOrderProduct` which extends `OrderProductEntity`, adding additional fields such as productName, price, subTotal, sku, and image, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProduct
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a product in an order with display-friendly attributes like productName, price, subTotal, sku, and image.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the SKU of the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU of the product.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or identifier.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or identifier.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal price for this product.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal price for this product.
